items.problem: PointerPoint.PointerDevice.PointerDeviceType causes CS1061 after namespace rewrite because WinUI 3 flattened the property
items.evidence: skill-defects.json item 1; lessons.json errors_encountered[2] CS1061; dev_agent_struggles[1] second build failure
items.root_cause: WinUI 3's Microsoft.UI.Input.PointerPoint removed the .PointerDevice sub-object — .PointerDeviceType is now direct. The Initialize script did not rewrite this mechanical pattern and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md did not document it.
items.change: Add regex replacement '.PointerDevice.PointerDeviceType' → '.PointerDeviceType' to Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 step 3 (runs at bootstrap, cannot be ignored)
items.expected_effect: The PointerDevice flattening happens mechanically at bootstrap; no CS1061 error on first build
items.falsifiable_check: Re-run produces zero CS1061 errors mentioning 'PointerDevice' and requires one fewer build-fix cycle

items.problem: Same as above — backup documentation for agent-written code post-bootstrap
items.root_cause: If the agent writes new pointer-handling code (not copied from UWP source), it needs to know the WinUI 3 API shape
items.change: Add 'Pointer input: API shape changes after namespace rewrite' section to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md with anchor #pointer-input
items.expected_effect: Agent generating new PointerPoint code uses .PointerDeviceType directly instead of .PointerDevice.PointerDeviceType
items.falsifiable_check: No CS1061 for PointerDevice in any build cycle; agent uses correct pattern in new code
